purpose: Define a homogeneous blocker vocabulary for detection, triage, and reporting.

blocker_types.definition: Execution is waiting on an artifact, contract, approval, or bounded deliverable from another owner.
entry_criteria: a dependency request is open past its due time
a handoff needed for progress has not been accepted
the item cannot continue without an external deliverable
exit_criteria: ownership moved and the dependency is no longer external

severity_guidance.sev1: The current round cannot complete without the dependency in the next hour.
severity_guidance.sev2: The package objective is at risk during the same work cycle.
severity_guidance.sev3: Progress pauses but the round still advances elsewhere.
severity_guidance.sev4: The item waits without immediate effect on round stability.

detection_signals: checkpoint states waiting on external owner

blocker_types.definition: Execution is paused because the requested outcome, acceptance criteria, or ownership boundary is unclear or contradictory.
entry_criteria: acceptance criteria conflict with packet scope
work item references paths outside ownership without a handoff
two active instructions point to different outcomes
exit_criteria: ownership and acceptance criteria match the packet
the item is re-scoped and re-published

severity_guidance.sev1: Ambiguity threatens the entire round or could trigger unsafe changes.
severity_guidance.sev2: The package cannot proceed on a committed item.
severity_guidance.sev3: Clarification is needed before the next checkpoint.
severity_guidance.sev4: The ambiguity affects a queued item only.

blocker_types.definition: Execution is limited by environment, filesystem, runtime, or tooling conditions rather than by task content.
entry_criteria: a deterministic tool path or config cannot be loaded
exit_criteria: impacted flow moved to a healthy path

severity_guidance.sev1: Control-plane work is stopped or data safety is threatened.
severity_guidance.sev2: A package cannot complete planned execution in the current work cycle.
severity_guidance.sev3: A degraded path exists but throughput is reduced.
severity_guidance.sev4: The issue is localized and recoverable without schedule risk.

blocker_types.definition: Execution output exists but cannot proceed because validation, evidence, or readiness gates failed.
entry_criteria: integration safety checks reject the item

severity_guidance.sev1: Unsafe output is about to enter integration.
severity_guidance.sev2: The item cannot be accepted in the current round.
severity_guidance.sev3: The item is conditionally acceptable pending corrective evidence.
severity_guidance.sev4: The issue is minor and does not threaten immediate flow.

classification_rules.statement: Assign the blocker type that best describes the first external condition preventing progress.
When the outcome is clear but another owner is late, classify as dependency.
When acceptance criteria are unclear, classify as scope even if validation also fails.
When the control-plane or execution environment is unavailable, classify as infra.
